title: Catch Ya In A Bit Guide Service
specs: Fishing on Lake Winnipesaukee, New Hampshire's largest and most popular lake
Target species include smallmouth bass, largemouth bass, lake trout, rainbow trout, white perch, yellow perch, chain pickerel
Ice fishing with top of the line gear including heated shelters and transportation on ice
Valid New Hampshire fishing license required
Ages 5 and up for smallmouth bass and ice fishing trips
Ages 9 and up for largemouth bass trips
Boat trips accommodate up to 3 people comfortably, 4 including children but tight for casting
Group ice fishing trips available for 7 or more people by arrangement
